literal_source_claim_en: The Fourier series of an L^p function converges almost everywhere.
statement_family_frozen_not_credited_as_: A candidate classical family concerns almost-everywhere convergence of symmetric Fourier partial sums of a complex-valued periodic function satisfying a source-selected L^p condition with p > 1; the exponent endpoint, circle or interval model, period, measure and Fourier normalizations, function or Lp-class representation, cutoff, and representative remain open.
statement_blocker: The catalog gloss does not state the range of p, domain, period, scalar field, measure and Fourier normalizations, function-versus-Lp-class model, partial-sum convention, representative, or exact convergence expression. The likely 1968 primary paper was identified only through metadata and its exact theorem text was not inspected. Choosing the familiar external formalization's binder list would substitute unreviewed mathematics for the repository source.
